# Consolidated test-period results (generated by `scripts/build_results_table.py`)

Every model on every task, test period 2024-07-01 to 2025-06-24, from the saved predictions of the single test runs. MAE in MW; skill = 1 - MAE / MAE of the better naive baseline of the same task on the same samples. The tuning budgets differ between models and tasks (see `reports/research_question_answers.md` and the protocol log); differences between models are only meaningful with the paired intervals in the other reports. Day-ahead = forecasts issued at 10:00 on the previous day for the 24 hours of a day (8,611 hours); the other tasks are direct forecasts at the stated horizon from every hourly origin.

Not evaluated: SARIMAX, Prophet, TCN and Transformer (dropped before any run; see `docs/limitations.md`). The GRU was evaluated at 1 h, 24 h and the day-ahead task only; LSTM L1 at 1-48 h and in the day-ahead task.
